summary: The candidate is a valid partial cleanup and regression guard for model IDs that are already centralized in multimodal_gen/test/test_utils.py. It reproduces and removes 20 such executable duplicates, and its focused tests pass. It does not fully enforce the original common-entry refactor: repeated runnable model IDs without an existing DEFAULT_* constant remain hard-coded and are invisible to the guard. The candidate should not be described as a complete fix of the original issue.

gpu_execution.evidence: The candidate changes Python test references and an AST policy test, not inference or numerical code. The node exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X, while the directly touched DP runtime case needs two GPUs; Ascend and MUSA execution require unavailable architectures. GPU inference would not establish completeness of the source-refactor contract.

remaining_counterexamples: python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/server/gpu_cases.py retains four executable occurrences of Lightricks/LTX-2.3; no matching shared constant exists, so the guard cannot report them.
Lightricks/LTX-2 remains hard-coded across server/gpu_cases.py and server/ascend/testcase_configs_npu.py; no matching shared constant exists.
FastVideo/FastHunyuan-diffusers remains hard-coded across server/gpu_cases.py and server/musa/testcase_configs_musa.py; no matching shared constant exists.
Rabinovich/LongLive-2.0-5B-Diffusers remains hard-coded twice in server/gpu_cases.py; no matching shared constant exists.

The guard excludes the complete unit tree, where the independent inventory found 57 literals equal to existing shared constants. Some are intentional parser/config test vectors, but the blanket exclusion does not distinguish those from ordinary reusable test fixtures.
remaining_limitations: Recommendation is request_changes because the candidate is partial hardening, not a full original-issue fix.
No native files changed, repository-environment.json declares native and wheel as null, and no native rebuild was applicable.
Only one ROCm GPU was assigned; the touched two-GPU DP runtime case was not executed.
Ascend and MUSA accelerator paths were syntax-checked but could not be executed on the ROCm host.
Gated model credentials/weights were unavailable and unnecessary for the source-level contract; no semantic or numerical model claim was made.

An attempted broad import of all touched configuration modules triggered model metadata access (including gated 401 responses), demonstrating that collection/import is not a clean architecture-neutral runtime test; it was not counted as proof of correctness.
